name: Deploy Sgula

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  PROJECT_ID: sgula-task2-insy7315
  REGION: us-central1
  SERVICE_NAME: sgula-website
  ARTIFACT_REPOSITORY: sgula
  IMAGE_NAME: sgula-website

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # Checks out the exact commit that triggered the deployment.
      # Keeping deployment tied to a Git revision makes the deployed
      # version reproducible (GitHub, 2026).
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # Authentication credentials are stored as a GitHub repository
      # secret instead of being committed to source control
      # (Google, 2026).
      - name: Authenticate to Google Cloud
        uses: google-github-actions/auth@v3
        with:
          project_id: ${{ env.PROJECT_ID }}
          credentials_json: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_CREDENTIALS }}

      - name: Set up Google Cloud CLI
        uses: google-github-actions/setup-gcloud@v2
        with:
          project_id: ${{ env.PROJECT_ID }}

      # Builds the supporting ASP.NET Core website as a container image.
      # Containerisation provides a consistent runtime between CI and
      # production (Microsoft, 2026).
      - name: Build website container
        run: |
          gcloud builds submit \
            --tag ${{ env.REGION }}-docker.pkg.dev/${{ env.PROJECT_ID }}/${{ env.ARTIFACT_REPOSITORY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ github.sha }} \
            .

      # Deploys the commit-specific image to Cloud Run.
      - name: Deploy website to Cloud Run
        run: |
          gcloud run deploy ${{ env.SERVICE_NAME }} \
            --image ${{ env.REGION }}-docker.pkg.dev/${{ env.PROJECT_ID }}/${{ env.ARTIFACT_REPOSITORY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ github.sha }} \
            --region ${{ env.REGION }} \
            --platform managed \
            --allow-unauthenticated

      # Firebase CLI deploys the Firebase resources from the same
      # repository revision.
      - name: Install Firebase CLI
        run: npm install -g firebase-tools

      - name: Deploy Firebase resources
        run: |
          firebase deploy \
            --project ${{ env.PROJECT_ID }} \
            --only hosting,functions,firestore:rules,firestore:indexes

# Reference List
# Firebase, 2026. Firebase CLI reference. [online]
# Available at: https://firebase.google.com/docs/cli
# [Accessed 28 September 2026].
#
# GitHub, 2026. GitHub Actions documentation. [online]
# Available at: https://docs.github.com/en/actions
# [Accessed 28 September 2026].
#
# Google, 2026. google-github-actions/auth. [online]
# Available at: https://github.com/google-github-actions/auth
# [Accessed 28 September 2026].
#
# Microsoft, 2026. .NET container images. [online]
# Available at: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/core/docker/container-images
# [Accessed 28 September 2026].
